FN-W13SH99-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 303
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/09/2025
Senate Bill 303 as introduced could increase or decrease the annual obligations of the Education
Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the number of
principals and assistant principals that would be eligible to receive additional supplements for
serving in high poverty schools under existing law and the number that would be eligible
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-W13SH99-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 303
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/21/2025
Senate Bill 303 as passed the Senate could decrease the annual obligations of the Education
Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of stipends of up to $5,000
that principals and assistant principals would no longer be eligible to receive for serving in
certain high poverty schools as provided by this bill.
Page 1

obligations of the Education Trust Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
amount of stipends of up to $5,000 that principals and assistant principals would no longer be
eligible to receive for serving in certain high poverty schools as provided by this bill.
